package internalapi

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/onboardingcontract"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

type StudentOnboardingDraftGetter interface {
	Handle(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error)
}

type StudentOnboardingDraftPutter interface {
	Handle(context.Context, studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error)
}

type StudentOnboardingDraftFinalizer interface {
	Handle(context.Context, studentuc.FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraftInput) (domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult, error)
}

type StudentOnboardingProfileGetter interface {
	Handle(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentOnboarding, error)
}

func (h *Handler) GetTeacherStudentOnboardingState(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.OnboardingDrafts == nil || h.OnboardingProfiles == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student onboarding is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	studentID := chi.URLParam(r, "studentID")
	draft, err := h.OnboardingDrafts.Handle(r.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		onboardingcontract.WriteError(w, err)
		return
	}
	profileVersion := int64(0)
	profile, err := h.OnboardingProfiles.Handle(r.Context(), studentID)
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
	case err != nil:
		onboardingcontract.WriteError(w, err)
		return
	default:
		profileVersion = profile.Version
	}
	state, err := domain.NewTeacherStudentOnboardingState(draft, profileVersion)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "student onboarding state is invalid", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(state)
}

func (h *Handler) PutTeacherStudentOnboardingDraft(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.OnboardingDraftWrites == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student onboarding draft is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request onboardingcontract.DraftReplaceRequest
	if err := onboardingcontract.DecodeJSON(w, r, onboardingcontract.DraftReplaceBodyLimit, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	draft, err := h.OnboardingDraftWrites.Handle(
		r.Context(),
		request.UseCaseInput(chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")),
	)
	if err != nil {
		onboardingcontract.WriteError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(draft)
}

func (h *Handler) FinalizeTeacherStudentOnboardingDraft(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.OnboardingFinalization == nil {
		http.Error(w, "student onboarding draft is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request onboardingcontract.DraftFinalizeRequest
	if err := onboardingcontract.DecodeJSON(w, r, onboardingcontract.DraftFinalizeBodyLimit, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.OnboardingFinalization.Handle(
		r.Context(),
		request.UseCaseInput(chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")),
	)
	if err != nil {
		onboardingcontract.WriteError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}
